name: openai-agents-python
description: A lightweight, powerful framework for multi-agent workflows
readme: The OpenAI Agents SDK is a lightweight yet powerful framework for building multi-agent workflows. It is provider-agnostic, supporting the OpenAI Responses and Chat Completions APIs, as well as 100+ other LLMs. [!NOTE] Looking for the JavaScript/TypeScript version? Check out Agents SDK JS/TS.
